name: Momose Riko
source: [url=/c37509]Touma's[/url] classmate who lives in the same dormitory. In order to pay rent, she draws eromanga in secret; however because she has no experience with men at all, her illustrations have no eroticism behind them. After Riko tells Touma about her secret, she requests him to help her out with her manga and use their sexual situations as references.
